name: Train Manager
detailed_description:
Become a CEO and Build Your Train Manager Tycoon Empire Today!

Embark on an exciting journey as the ultimate Train Manager! Strategize, manage, and conquer the railroads in this immersive locomotive manager tycoon game. Whether you dream of running a small fleet or ruling a global empire, you create your adventure yourself in one of the biggest train manager sims. Beat your friends and other real life managers on the leaderboards by controlling railway station routes.

Key Features

Train & Railway Station Realism: Indulge yourself in 30+ real train models and all the major railway stations you can imagine.

Manage Your Fleet: Experience huge car variety. Expand your tycoon empire to handle route and cargo diversity while you schedule repairs and maintenance.

Advanced Route Planning: Plan the most efficient route for optimal cargo or passenger delivery to every city and every station.

Dynamic Gameplay: Experience realistic economic markets to build a thriving manager business.

City & Railway Station Expansion: Build your logistics manager hub and grow it into other bustling cities as a locomotive tycoon, connecting your trade networks empire far and wide.

Train Car Customization: Upgrade each car to fit the needs of your passengers and adjust the price of tickets, speed, consumption, range and capacity.

Global Station Empire Connections: Track each train live between each city in your empire on the interactive map via satellite GPS.

Achievements & Rewards: Unlock exciting rewards as you progress and master the art of company railroad operations!

Real-Time Economics: Adapt to changing market conditions like the price of fuel, departure profit, ticket prices and fare dodgers.

A happy Railway staff: Recruit and develop a high-caliber executive team and staff to maximize your company’s potential and gain boosts.

You can hire a great crew, but only you, the manager, can become the CEO of an empire of cargo and travel routes and use your complicated tycoon strategy to be the next boss of delivery.

In this multiplayer manager you have the possibility to create a bigger empire than real tycoons such as Deutsche Bahn, SNCF, Central Japan, Union Pacific and Canadian National.

You can even ride while being idle on your couch to each station in eg. New York, Tokyo, London, Los Angeles, Shanghai, Paris and Seoul. Travel from America to Europe to Asia with the press of a button.

Take the most reliable tracks possible to transport your cargo or passengers. Not by rental car, metro, plane, bus, truck or ship - but by train. Build your train manager empire and dominate the routes!

Whether you're delivering goods between small towns or creating a multinational supply chain, this Train Manager tycoon lets you take control of every detail. The immersive graphics, engaging tycoon gameplay, and realistic train mechanics make this the ultimate train simulator for fans of strategy games.

Why Choose Train Manager?

From strategy to hands-on management, this railway station game offers unparalleled depth for those who love logistics, empire, manager, cargo, tycoon and city-building games. Build your empire and prove you’re the ultimate manager tycoon!

Download this Train Manager tycoon now and start your journey toward locomotive greatness!

An internet-connection is required to play this tycoon game.

Train Manager is among the most realistic of the simulator genre - so prove yourself and beat your friends and other real life managers.
